result.summary: Found 2 visual defects: a clipped UI icon and an unstyled placeholder element in a restaurant card image.

issues.description: The green location pin icon next to the 'Weizenbergi 20, Tallinn' delivery address is partially cut off by the left edge of the screen, making the icon incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add left padding to the delivery address container so the full location pin icon is visible within the screen bounds and aligns properly with the text.

issues.description: The ramen bowl image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' contains an unstyled solid green square placeholder block instead of the expected portion of the dish (likely a missing image asset), creating a visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Replace the green placeholder block with the correct image asset to complete the ramen bowl graphic and maintain visual coherence with the rest of the dish imagery.
